query:
SELECT 
  TABLE_NAME,
  TABLE_TYPE,
  TABLE_ROWS,
  DATA_LENGTH,
  INDEX_LENGTH
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;
